newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan to announce paging licence winners Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to announce paging licence winners Thursday.

text.p: Taiwan was scheduled to award eight licences on Thursday to operate paging system in the island's newly liberalising telecommunication market, officials said.

"We will start the bidding at 16.00 p.m. (0800 GMT) and final result is expected to come out at around 20.00 p.m. (1200 GMT)," Su Chung-hung, a director at the communication ministry's Directorate General of Telecommuncations, told Reuters.
Su said the ministry will award eight licences for paging system out of 32 applications.
Several local applicants have teamed up with foreign partners, including Hong Kong Telecom and Singapore Telecom, the official said.
Taiwan granted eight licences to operate the island's mobile telephone franchises early in January.

The mobile telephone and paging sectors are among several liberalised by the parliament in January 1996 when it dismantled a decades-old state monopoly by opening them up for private and limited foreign investments. -- Taipei Newsroom (2-5080815)
